title: Neither Being nor Non-being
translation: Then there was neither non-being nor being; there was no air, nor sky beyond it. What covered it all? Where? In whose protection? Was there water, deep and unfathomable?
translation_hi: तब न असत् था, न सत् था; न वायु था, न उसके परे आकाश। सबको किसने ढका था? कहाँ? किसके आश्रय में? क्या गहरा, अथाह जल था?
science: The Nasadiya Sukta asks what existed before the universe, the same question cosmology asks about the moment before the Big Bang.
